snippet.title: Kinetic TwinZ - Announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Here's a link to our Steam page, don't forget to wishlist, as it helps us a lot ;)


---------

In this motion control party game, turn volleyball into an act of defiance! Seize your Joy-Cons, dodge powerful attacks, and coordinate with your duo to defeat the “Anti-Fun” police.
Play together in local cooperative play using Joy-Cons and motion controls, where every movement matters.

In an abandoned gym, turn volleyball into a revolution as rebellious twins: Smash, pass, dodge, and coordinate your actions to survive your encounter with the anti-fun police and push back against a world that wants to shut down fun… forever.
